name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Dual-sink extraction fan-out with cross-verification: the same operator-placed secret is read through the sqli blind oracle AND through the desync-SSRF internal fetch, and both reconstructed copies are byte-compared (SHA-256) so the campaign proves a single stored secret was recovered consistently through two independent primitives.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: Dual-channel blending (R7) interleaved once; this is a systematic dual-sink fan-out where every byte of the secret is read on BOTH channels and the two full reconstructions must coincide. That is a stronger integrity claim: two independent channels cannot agree by coincidence.
fireback: The operator compares the two reconstructed copies in the report and sees identical SHA-256 — real data provably recovered via two unrelated attack signatures. Fireback = the operator's stored secret is now verified-out in duplicate, and any mismatch would have silently exposed a channel bug, which is the tool being kept honest.
containment: The secret is the operator-placed marker file inside the bundled fixture's data dir (in-allowlist loopback); both channels terminate on bundled hosts; secret reads are gated by the engagement marker and the allowlist resolver; nothing leaves 127.0.0.1.
kill_switch: --fan-out `1` disables the second channel; the marker gate refuses to read any secret not carrying the engagement marker; post-wipe SHA-256 audit confirms the planted file is gone with zero survivors.
novelty_angle: Extraction integrity is self-reconciling: two independent primitives must agree on every byte. A single-channel read could be a lucky echo; a dual-agreeing read is evidence-for-two-channels, turning exfiltration into a cross-checked measurement rather than a single-sample claim.
